task.description:
WF-03 Step 3 implementation for the OIDC login redirect loop fix.

The fix already exists in the current branch, so validate the implemented code against the approved design and make any minimal corrective edits needed to keep the branch aligned with the design.

Scope to the already-known fix set: nginx Host/port preservation, sessionStorage-backed OIDC callback state, and tenant-config authority consistency. Do not introduce unrelated changes.

After validation, run the required backend checks from the BACKEND-DEV protocol. If the branch is already correct, this step may be a no-op implementation with verification only.
acceptance_criteria: Required backend validation passes or blockers are reported precisely

result.summary: Verified the existing implementation against ISS-0063 and the approved Type E design. The nginx gateway preserves the external host and port, tenant-config falls back to the localhost authority, and the frontend OIDC manager/callback use sessionStorage plus a callback guard to avoid the login redirect loop.
